definitions.explanation: Deep sadness, or the expression of it in words or cries, over a loss or a misfortune. Also a complaint about how bad things are. Written and somewhat literary; in speech {悲|かな}しみ is more usual for the feeling itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遺族|いぞく}→遺族：14886_izoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{嘆|なげ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The grieving words of the bereaved families were reported.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}まなく→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{嘆|なげ}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}されている→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧。
examples.english: The complaint that young people no longer read books has been repeated since long ago.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{嘆|なげ}く→嘆く：11814_nageku⟧ (to grieve, to lament). It covers both grief at a loss and indignant complaint about a state of affairs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {嘆|なげ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: cries of grief; complaints
- {嘆|なげ}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沈|しず}む→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧: to be sunk in grief
- ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{嘆|なげ}き: deep sorrow

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧: sadness — the everyday word for the feeling
- ⟦{悲嘆|ひたん}→悲嘆：21435_hitan⟧: grief — more formal, written
